description: This file defines the class EmployeeClaimRequestSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM Claim module. It extends another class for filtering claim request search parameters and specifies allowable sort fields for claim request searches.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that extends ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams, specifically for defining search filter parameters related to employee claim requests. It includes a constant listing allowed fields for sorting search results.

methods.name: ALLOWED_SORT_FIELDS
methods.description: A constant array defining the list of claim request fields that are allowed to be used as sorting criteria in search operations.

search-terms: PHP class for claim request filtering
